# CodePipelineProcessPayloadsByIdsRequest

The tool calls and transcript entries of a run to fetch, by id: typically the ones the run's references list that you don't have, or have at an older revision. It only reads, so you can repeat it safely.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toolUseIds` | `uuid[]` |  | The ids of the tool calls to fetch. At most 500; ask for more in further requests. Send an empty array for none. |
| `contextEntryIds` | `uuid[]` |  | The ids of the transcript entries to fetch. At most 500; ask for more in further requests. Send an empty array for none. |

## Example

```json
{
  "toolUseIds": [
    "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
  ],
  "contextEntryIds": [
    "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`pipelineRuns.payloads`](../api/pipeline-runs.md) (`POST /code-pipelines/processes/by-id/{id}/payloads/by-ids`)
